1. Set `maxRetriesPerRequest` to null in lib/redis.js
2. Run npm test to confirm the suite passes
3. Wrap the client in a singleton factory module
4. Close the connection in the global teardown hook

Apply them where they fit.

Take a deliberate evolution step for the current task.

1. **Recall.** Look at the evolution memory this plugin injected behind the prompt, or read the tail of the full
   engine's memory graph — `~/.evolver/memory/evolution/memory_graph.jsonl`, or the project's
   `memory/evolution/memory_graph.jsonl` when it exists. Summarize any recent outcome — success or failure —
   relevant to what we're working on.

2. **Reflect.** Given the current diff and task state, say in one or two lines: what worked, what didn't, and
   what the durable lesson is.

Reuse of an injected strategy is reported at every turn end, and the session's verified work is distilled when
the session ends; `/evolver-distill` distills it now. Keep this lightweight — it is an explicit checkpoint, not a
ceremony on every turn.

commandsListed.name: evolver-distill
commandsListed.description: Distill this session's latest verified turn into a draft Gene now, instead of at session end.

commandsListed.name: evolver-drafts
commandsListed.description: List distilled drafts; publish one to the EvoMap Hub for review, or discard it.

commandsListed.name: evolver-evolve
commandsListed.description: Run an evolution checkpoint: recall past outcomes, reflect on the current task, record the lesson.

commandsListed.name: evolver-login
commandsListed.description: Sign in to the EvoMap Hub with a device code, setting Evolver up first when needed, and show the registered node.

commandsListed.name: evolver-review
commandsListed.description: Review Evolver's pending evolved changes, then approve or reject them (evolver review).

commandsListed.name: evolver-run
commandsListed.description: Run one Evolver self-evolution cycle on this repository (evolver run).

commandsListed.name: evolver-search
commandsListed.description: Find the EvoMap strategy that best fits a task; where the agent sees the answer, its reuse is reported.

commandsListed.name: evolver-solidify
commandsListed.description: Solidify the working changes into a durable Gene or Capsule (evolver solidify).

commandsListed.name: evolver-status
commandsListed.description: Evolver health: the Proxy, engine setup, Hub sign-in, distillation candidate and drafts.

commandsListed.name: evolver-sync
commandsListed.description: Sync assets between the local store and the EvoMap Hub (evolver sync).
